rows.text: 压缩空气作用于转换器，使通向车轮制动器的液压回路中的制动液产生压力。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 转换方向相反：转换器利用空气压力在制动液压回路中产生压力。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 压力调节器根据储气罐内的压力控制压缩机的供气。
evidence: Bendix D-2 Governor, SD-01-503, p. 1, Description, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/BrddZ4M0I0EBhB_SD-01-503_US_005.pdf: governor starts or stops compression via the unloader at reservoir pressure limits.

rows.text: 空气干燥器处理压缩空气，减少进入气路的水分。
evidence: NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.
Bendix BW5057P6, Air Dryers, p. 10, https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/inv/2020/INRD-PE20003-10834.pdf: dryer removes liquid water and vapor before air reaches reservoirs.

rows.text: 压缩空气由压缩机产生；转换器利用其作用力使通向制动器的液压油产生压力。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 手控阀可不用踏板来实施制动；在某些系统中，它控制应急制动。
evidence: Clark Straight Air & Air Over Hydraulic Brake Manual 9093, foreword and pp. 14, 24, https://www.tractorparts.com/PDFs/CLARK_BRAKES_AIR_AND_AIR_OVER_HYDRAULICS_SVC_BOOK_9093.pdf: its air-over-hydraulic system includes a hand valve; pulling it manually applies secondary braking.

rows.text: 转换器把压缩空气的作用力传给液压油，液压油到达并操作车轮制动器。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 由踏板操作的双回路制动阀调节送往行车制动回路的空气。
evidence: Bendix E-6 and E-10 Dual Brake Valves, SD-03-817, p. 1, Description and Operation, https://n0c357rmy1njbuit2friqwu.blob.core.windows.net/documents/QIYhwtZHI0EBhB_SD-03-817_1_US_007001.pdf: pedal-operated dual valve has separate supply and delivery circuits and graduated control of the brakes.

rows.text: 在这种系统中，液压回路操作车轮制动器；它不是作用于传动轴的制动器。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 气液制动系统可操作车轮的行车制动器，使车辆减速和停止；它不只是辅助缓速器。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 压缩机产生压缩空气，储存在储气罐中供制动回路使用。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

rows.text: 压缩机由发动机通过机械连接驱动，向储气罐供气。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

WABCO Maintenance Manual 31, section 1, pp. 1–2, https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/mm31_web.pdf: example compressor is engine-mounted, coupling-driven and supplies pressurized air for vehicle brakes.

rows.text: 储气罐储存压缩空气，以供系统工作使用。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

rows.text: 制动回路使用独立的液压制动液，与润滑发动机的机油分开。
evidence: NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air-over-hydraulic system includes separate brake fluid reservoirs and wheel brake cylinders.

GM 2011 SRX Owner Manual, Brake Fluid, https://contentdelivery.ext.gm.com/bypass/gma-content-api/resources/sites/GMA/content/staging/MANUALS/1000/MA1294/en_US/4.0/2k11srxOM-6321118760061309583.pdf: specified brake fluid is used in the hydraulic system; engine oil contaminates and can damage its components.

rows.text: 转换器连接气动和液压两部分：压缩空气的作用力使液压制动液产生压力。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 液压油的可压缩性很低，因此能将压力从转换器传至车轮制动器。
evidence: NASA Glenn Research Center, Pascal’s Principle and Hydraulics, https://www.grc.nasa.gov/WWW/K-12/WindTunnel/Activities/Pascals_principle.html: nearly incompressible hydraulic fluid transmits force.
California Highway Patrol HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: air-hydraulic boosters actuate hydraulic service brakes at the wheels.

rows.text: 压缩机由发动机驱动，而不是由向车轮传递动力的传动轴驱动。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

WABCO Maintenance Manual 31, section 1, pp. 1–2, https://www.zf.com/products/media/automotive/cv/literature_downloads_wna/truck_solutions/air_processing_maintenance_manuals_/mm31_web.pdf: example compressor is engine-mounted, coupling-driven and supplies pressurized air for vehicle brakes.

rows.text: 在转换器中，压缩空气的作用力传给液压油，再由液压油操作车轮制动器。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 转换器是制动系统的部件：它将气动力传给操作车轮制动器的液压回路。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 该系统使用压缩空气和液压油传递制动作用；水不是规定的工作介质。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 保护阀让空气流入储气罐；当某个相连回路发生故障时，它能防止其他储气罐也排空，从而为未发生故障的回路保留空气。
evidence: Provincia autonoma di Trento, Quesiti ispettore revisioni, modulo C, C1A058, https://www.provincia.tn.it/content/download/5130/51394/file/quiz%2Bmod.%2Bc.pdf: the reservoir protection valve permits filling and prevents a fault in one connected circuit from draining the other reservoirs.

rows.text: 该回路结合压缩空气部分和液压部分，转换器在两者之间传递作用力。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 纯气压制动中，空气作用于执行器；转换器用于接入液压部分的系统。
evidence: Clark Straight Air & Air Over Hydraulic Brake Manual 9093, foreword and pp. 20–23, https://www.tractorparts.com/PDFs/CLARK_BRAKES_AIR_AND_AIR_OVER_HYDRAULICS_SVC_BOOK_9093.pdf: compares air directly applying brakes with air operating hydraulic power clusters.

rows.text: 压缩空气为操作液压回路的转换器提供作用力，并非用于冷却制动蹄。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

NHTSA interpretation nht92-4.20, manufacturer system description, https://www.nhtsa.gov/es/interpretations/nht92-420: air dryer, governor, reservoirs, service and parking controls, converters, fluid reservoirs and wheel brakes in an air-over-hydraulic system.

rows.text: 液压油将压力传给车轮制动部件，并非用于润滑轮胎。
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, chapter 6 §6(b)(1), https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: engine-driven compressor, reservoirs, air-hydraulic boosters and wheel service brakes.

The explanation assumes an overpressure relief valve; the cited relief-valve examples do not establish that this is the protection valve intended here. A multi-circuit protection valve instead isolates a failed circuit to preserve the others (ZF/WABCO-style protection valves; see https://www.vadenoriginal.com/it/prodotti/categoria/valvola-di-protezione-a-4-circuiti-370). Establish the intended type or explain protection without asserting an unsupported mechanism.
